mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT 'DR' AS recordType, MDFM_CLS_CD AS recordDetailType, MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq FROM ODS.S_MRDDRAFE WHERE OP_EXPT_REG_ID = #{opExptRegId} AND MDFM_CLS_CD = #{mdfmClsCd}

SELECT SUBSTR(INPT_HMI, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(INPT_HMI, 3, 2) AS inptHmi, INPT_VAL_CNTE AS inptValCnte FROM ODS.S_MRDDRARE WHERE OP_EXPT_REG_ID = #{opExptRegId} AND AFCHG_ANRM_REC_VAL_ID IS NULL ORDER BY INPT_HMI
SELECT OP_NM AS opNm, (SELECT MAX(Z.STF_NM) FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.SID = A.PFDR_SID) AS stfNm FROM ODS.S_MOOOPPAM A WHERE OP_EXPT_REG_ID = #{opExptRegId}
